entries.338ea22b9c8f9fea: The core business, which supports customer companies' recruitment and use of personnel through internet job sites and the like, has revenue from external customers of ¥48,239 million for the fiscal year ended February 2026. The breakdown is media (job advertising) services of ¥46,048 million, agent (placement) services of ¥1,848 million, and other services of ¥342 million. The company operates the part-time job site 'Baitoru', the spot part-time job service 'Spot Baitoru', the full-time and contract job site 'Baitoru NEXT', the general job site 'Hatarakonet', the professional job site 'Baitoru PRO', the nurse placement service 'Nurse de Hatarako', and the caregiver placement service 'Kaigo de Hatarako'.
